**1. (HIGH) — Appendix B / Physics critic / "The design uses 512 cells of 280 Ah. At a nominal LFP voltage of 3.2 V, the total energy capacity is 512 * 280 Ah * 3.2 V = 458.75 kWh. **2. (HIGH) — Appendix B / Physics critic / "The brief explicitly requires a glycol-water liquid cooling loop, external dry cooler, and an integrated chiller with R454B refrigerant. No such thermal management module or components are present in the design" / Module 2/3 text exists but physics gate detected zero cold plates, pumps, manifolds or chiller in the actual BoM graph / Re-run with enforced thermal module emission and cold-plate count matching cell modules (32+).**

**3. (HIGH) — Section 6 BoM + Appendix A / 88 fabricated or unverifiable part numbers (e.g., "TS-8-800-2200", "C11000-300A", "RESIBLOC-300KVA", "B32778E4155K000") / Engine stripped 88 SKUs but left gaps; many are descriptive strings or non-existent catalogue numbers / Replace all fabricated SKUs with verified catalogue items or explicit "custom fab" lines before any procurement.**

**4. (HIGH) — Appendix B / Physics critic / "The cell string fuses (Mersen M506-30A-500V) are rated for 30 A … system continuous current is 300 A … These fuses will blow instantly" + similar contactor (LEV200A4ANA = 200 A) and capacitor (1.5 µF claimed as 4700 µF) errors / No first-principles current/voltage or energy-storage sizing pass / Re-size all protection and DC-link components to 350–500 A / 1000 V DC ratings with realistic capacitor bank volume.**

**5. (MED) — Section 2 / Regulatory & Compliance / "Compliance gate WARN: 1 mandatory standard not declared … IEC 62619" + missing explicit UL 9540A test-method citation in brief / Brief omitted cell-level safety standard required for UK/EU stationary LFP / Add IEC 62619 (and confirm UL 9540A propagation test protocol) to brief and re-emit compliance matrix.**

**6. (MED) — Section 6 BoM cover + cost stack / "£247,995.07 raw … £1.2 per kWh installed — 99% below typical" + later note "Post-override raw BoM = £93/kWh" / Prices pulled from heat-pump corpus or web guesses; cells at £60 each are ~40% below realistic LFP pack-level cost / Anchor all major lines (cells, PCS, container, chiller) to BESS-specific 2024–2026 reference medians before any cost-stack use.**

**7. (LOW) — Overall document / 78 pages, ~381 KB vs prior heat-pump reports 7–7.5 MB / Missing detailed thermal CFD, full FMEA tables, cable schedules, single-line diagrams, and 3-D layout drawings / Increase generation depth for BESS class or add explicit "deferred to Phase 5" placeholders for missing engineering artefacts.**
